speaker: Doctor
text: I understand the cardiologist's assessment, but the absence of orthopnea and PND makes typical heart failure less likely as the primary cause of this specific dry cough. text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) presenting as chronic cough. The confirmed heart failure is likely a comorbidity, but the specific mechanism for your dry, nocturnal cough is acid reflux irritating the airway. I recommend starting a trial of proton pump inhibitors and lifestyle modifications to see if the cough resolves.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Chronic Cough secondary to Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
